description: The vocabulary list_components filters by: the category tree, the tags in use, the authors with a published control, or the hosts a control can run in, each with its slug and a count. Use it to turn a name a person used into a slug; it returns no controls, so pass the slug to list_components to see them. Not paged — categories come back as a full tree and authors as a full list, while tags are capped at the 500 most used.
name: list_taxonomy

children.description: Child categories, in the same shape. Categories only.

componentsCount.description: How many published controls this covers.

slug.description: Pass to list_components as its category, tag, author or host filter.

title: List categories, tags, authors or hosts
